units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite>, beg. [read:] <he>נ׳ שהיה מפוחו פתוח באמצע פלטיא ופתח בנו זהבי מפוח כנגדו</he> a smith whose open shop was in the middle of the road, and whose son, a jeweler, opened a smithy opposite him; Tanḥ. Vayesheb 1; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:2">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top, a. e. <he>בן הנ׳</he> the smith’s son, i.e. R. Johanan, v. next w.—Pl. <he>נַפָּחִין</he>. Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13ᵇ <he>ולא של נ׳</he> nor dare an oven for smiths be put up (without the precautions mentioned in the Mishnah).
